notes.title: Fables of Talumos Sale!
notes.content:
It's been a little while since the last sale, so I wanted to make Fables of Talumos a little more available to those who might be a bit light in the ol' money department.  

The game is a retro-style top down adventure game with a variety of bosses, enemies, items and even weapons.  Fables of Talumos is a story-driven game, but much can be learned of the world if you take the time to look around and chat with the locals.  

If you do decide to pick up Fables of Talumos, please feel free to leave a short review with your honest opinions :)

notes.title: Cheesemaster Games Announces its Second Game - Spirittea
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35105745/82a2073e82581d255e7755856c65f65d8641519f.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=VixbwO5-_Eg;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheesemaster Games is proud to announce the Kickstarter campaign for our second game, Spirittea!  
Spirittea is a game about relaxing in the countryside while managing a bath house for spirits. 
 
Check out the Kickstarter page here: http://kck.st/2SUbSH9

The Kickstarter campaign will run from January 1 - 30, 2020.

notes.title: == For Press and Testers: Save File Reset Upon Launch Tomorrow ==
notes.content:
***********************************************************************************
This is an update intended for anyone who has received [b]press [/b]or [b]beta access[/b] to the game.  
***********************************************************************************

The game will be launching tomorrow as an updated version.  Unfortunately as I am in the middle of moving from one province to another I don't have access to my PC (just a laptop), and thus don't have access to the files needed to preserve the save data. 

I apologize to anyone who might lose progress in this way.  Please bear with me as I learn the ropes as well as best practices. 

Sincerely, 

The Cheesemaster

notes.title: Join the Fables of Talumos Discord!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

If you're interested, come check out the Fables of Talumos discord.  I post updates on the game's development, screenshots of what's to come, and am around to answer any questions you might have!  Maybe you can even become a bug tester and try out the game early!

[b]Check out the Discord server[/b]: https://discord.gg/QVQnFbw

I hope to see you there!

-The Cheesemaster
